entry.label: Adaptation
entry.description: Adaptation is relational: change is adaptive only with respect to some environment, timescale and viability condition. Local adjustment can make the larger system more fragile.
entry.canonical_definition: Change in a system's organisation, behaviour or relations that improves or preserves its capacity to remain viable in a changing environment.

profile.title: Adaptation
profile.canonical_definition: Change in a system's organisation, behaviour or relations that improves or preserves its capacity to remain viable in a changing environment.
profile.summary: Adaptation is relational: change is adaptive only with respect to some environment, timescale and viability condition. Local adjustment can make the larger system more fragile.
profile.why_it_matters: Transformation programmes often demand change without specifying what environmental variety has changed or what identity must be preserved. The result is motion rather than adaptation.
practice_connections: state what changed in the environment
retain variety and slack for unknown change
common_misreadings: change at one level helps every level
profile.editorial_note: Readable orientation and evidence-backed first pass. Named editorial review is still required before canonical acceptance.
